title: Corneal Endothelial Safety and Intraocular Pressure Outcomes of MicroPulse Laser Trabeculoplasty in Treatment-Naïve Glaucoma: A Six-Month Retrospective Study

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license, ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Newly diagnosed, treatment-naive open-angle glaucoma (POAG 48 eyes, pseudoexfoliation glaucoma 22 eyes; Shaffer grade 3-4); previous intraocular or laser surgery, contact lens wear, corneal disease, uveitis and diabetes excluded; one eye per patient

groups.description: MicroPulse laser trabeculoplasty (577 nm Easyret, micropulse mode, 300 um, 300 ms, 1000 mW, 360 degrees, 10% or 15% duty cycle by surgeon); no IOP-lowering medication during follow-up; retrospective consecutive cohort

exclusions.reason: Model estimates and p-values, not measured group means

exclusions.what: Table 1 baseline ECD by subtype (POAG, PEX)
exclusions.reason: Follow-up ECD is not tabulated by subtype (only in a supplementary table not part of the source XML); the whole-cohort series is used
Not ECD group means at follow-up times

notes: Procedure context 'glaucoma' (laser trabeculoplasty as glaucoma treatment); the protocol lists laser iridotomy under 'other' but laser trabeculoplasty is a glaucoma procedure applied to treat glaucoma itself.
Single-arm cohort of a standard clinical laser treatment without an investigational agent: control role.
Duty cycle (10% vs 15%) is confounded with surgeon (Methods); both are pooled in the tabulated cohort.

series.baseline_label: Baseline = pre-laser ECD of the treated eye (Table 2 column 'Baseline'; Methods: specular microscopy at baseline and 1, 3 and 6 months)
series.notes: Table 2 row 'Endothelial cell density (cells/mm2)'; footnote: mean ± SD with the number of eyes examined at that visit in parentheses (used for n_by_time).
